author: assistant-authored, source-checked draft
split_policy: 24 development and 16 reserved test questions. Test questions use different primary evidence pages from development questions. Never tune against test-query results. Corpus-aware questions are not an independent public benchmark.

questions.question: What global growth rate does Goldman Sachs expect for 2025, and how does it compare with trend?
questions.expected_answer: 3.1%, above a 2.9% trend.

required_evidence.excerpt: We expect global economic growth to reach 3.1% in 2025, compared to its 2.9% trend rate.

questions.question: What US growth rate does Goldman Sachs forecast for 2025, compared with US trend growth?
questions.expected_answer: 2.3%, compared with 1.9% trend.

required_evidence.excerpt: US growth of 2.3%, which is above trend growth of 1.9%.

questions.expected_answer: 1.0% projected versus 1.2% trend.

required_evidence.excerpt: Eurozone growth of 1.0%, which is slightly below trend growth of 1.2%.

questions.question: What UK growth and trend rates are stated in Goldman Sachs 2025 outlook?

required_evidence.excerpt: UK growth of 1.2%, which is also slightly below trend growth of 1.4%.

questions.question: How does Goldman Sachs expected Japanese growth compare with its trend rate?
